name: CLOT x Nike Air Force 1 Supreme TZ 'Chinese Candy Box'
story_html: Nike teams up with Hong Kong-based luxury brand CLOT to celebrate the Chinese New Year with the Nike Air Force 1 Supreme TZ 'Chinese Candy Box' sneaker. The 2009 design ditched the typical shoebox for a meticulous ‘Chinese Candy Box’ packaging set—a red box in a hexagonal shape with festive graphics, an interior tray layer for shoe accessories, CLOT graphics on the back and a matching lid. The low-top sneaker comes dressed in red and black, with subtle motifs etched along the upper.
